WITH long_rentals AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    rental_rate / rental_duration AS rate_per_day
  FROM film
  WHERE rental_duration > 5
),
rating_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(rate_per_day) AS avg_rate_per_day,
    COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM long_rentals
  GROUP BY rating
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS benchmark_value
  FROM rating_stats
)
SELECT 
  rs.rating,
  rs.avg_rate_per_day,
  rs.film_count,
  rs.avg_rate_per_day / b.benchmark_value AS ratio_to_benchmark
FROM rating_stats rs
CROSS JOIN benchmark b
WHERE b.benchmark_value IS NOT NULL
